text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...Hm? The Trainer's Office... the lights 
are on.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
............ It's already quite late at 
night.
choice_data_list: Ah, sorry! I'll be done soon!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apologizing as I did so, I printed out the 
documents. I handed the freshly completed 
papers to Believe.

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list: Training menu. I changed it up a little!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I'll put that into practice next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Good work. That was an extraordinary run. 
Your endurance... is something I ought to 
learn from.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, did something happen? 
You've seemed to be in good spirits 
lately.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"However... Trainer did make some 
improvements to the menu the other day."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"So, to that extent—I'm simply responding 
in kind."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so... You met a wonderful 
King, didn't you?
